project_description: A web-based application designed to streamline and centralize employee leave application, approval, and management processes, replacing existing manual tracking methods.

executive_summary.project_overview: The Employee Leave Management System (ELMS) is a proposed web-based solution intended to digitalize and automate the entire leave management lifecycle within the organization. This system will enable employees to apply for various types of leave, provide managers with tools to review and act on these requests, and empower HR administrators with capabilities to manage employee accounts, define leave policies, and generate organizational reports. The primary goal is to transition from a paper-based, manual system to an efficient, transparent, and secure digital platform.
executive_summary.business_problem: The current manual leave tracking process is characterized by significant administrative overhead, potential for data inconsistencies, delays in approvals, and a lack of real-time visibility into leave balances and organizational leave patterns. This leads to inefficiencies, increased paperwork, and potential employee dissatisfaction due to cumbersome procedures and lack of transparency regarding their leave entitlements and request statuses.
executive_summary.business_need: There is a critical business need for a centralized, digital system that simplifies leave application, accurately tracks and maintains employee leave balances, provides an efficient workflow for managers to approve or reject requests, offers comprehensive leave history, and significantly reduces the reliance on manual paperwork. Such a system is essential for improving operational efficiency, ensuring compliance, and enhancing the overall employee experience.
executive_summary.proposed_solution: The proposed solution is a web-based Employee Leave Management System comprising three distinct modules: an Employee Module for leave application and personal tracking, a Manager Module for request review and approval, and an HR Module for administrative tasks such as account creation, policy management, and reporting. The system will feature secure authentication, role-based access control, and a responsive user interface to ensure accessibility and usability across various devices.
business_benefits: Streamlined and automated leave application and approval processes, reducing manual effort and administrative burden.
Improved accuracy of leave balance tracking and entitlement management, minimizing errors and disputes.
Enhanced transparency for employees regarding their leave balances, request statuses, and historical data.
Faster decision-making for managers through centralized access to pending requests and employee leave history.
Better compliance with company leave policies and regulatory requirements through standardized workflows and robust data management.
Reduced paperwork and environmental impact by digitalizing the entire leave management process.
Data-driven insights for HR administrators through comprehensive reporting on organization-wide leave patterns.
executive_summary.expected_outcome: The successful implementation of the Employee Leave Management System will result in a highly efficient, user-friendly, and secure digital platform for managing all aspects of employee leave. This will lead to significant improvements in operational efficiency, data accuracy, and employee satisfaction, while providing robust reporting capabilities for HR and ensuring seamless integration into the organization's existing HR ecosystem.

epics.title: Employee Self-Service Leave Management
epics.business_objective: Empower employees with an intuitive and efficient platform to manage their leave applications, track balances, and view request statuses independently.
epics.business_value: Increases employee autonomy and satisfaction, reduces administrative burden on HR and managers for basic inquiries, and provides transparency on leave entitlements and history.
epics.detailed_description: This Epic covers all functionalities required for an employee to interact with the leave management system. It includes secure login, viewing personal leave balances, submitting new leave requests, selecting leave types, specifying dates and reasons, and monitoring the status of their submitted requests, including the ability to cancel pending ones. The goal is to provide a comprehensive self-service portal for employees.
scope: Employee secure login and logout functionality.
Display of current leave balances for various leave types.
Form for submitting new leave requests including type, dates, and reason.
Option to view a personal history of all past and pending leave requests.
Ability to cancel a pending leave request before manager approval.
Real-time updates on leave request status (Pending, Approved, Rejected).
out_of_scope: Complex leave accrual calculations beyond annual reset.
Detailed analytics on employee leave patterns beyond personal history.
assumptions: Employees have unique login credentials provided by HR.
Employees are assigned to a single department and have one primary reporting manager.
Leave balances are managed and reset annually by the HR system.
Standard leave types (e.g., Annual, Sick, Casual) are pre-defined.
Internet connectivity is available for system access.
dependencies: User authentication service must be available.
Backend APIs for leave balance retrieval and request submission must be functional.
Database schema for employee data and leave requests must be established.
risks: Poor user adoption due to a non-intuitive interface.
Security vulnerabilities in the authentication or data handling process.
Data integrity issues if leave balances are not accurately reflected.
Performance bottlenecks during peak usage periods.
Lack of clarity in leave policies leading to incorrect applications.
success_metrics: Percentage of leave applications submitted through the system.
Reduction in employee queries related to leave balances and status.
User satisfaction score from employee feedback (e.g., NPS).
Average time taken for an employee to submit a leave request.

features.title: Secure Employee Authentication
features.description: Enables employees to securely log into the system using their unique credentials and ensures role-based access to employee-specific functionalities.
functional_requirements: Employees shall be able to login securely.
technical_notes: Implement JWT for token-based authentication.
Use HTTPS for all communication.
Password hashing and salting required.
acceptance_criteria: Given an employee enters valid credentials, they shall be successfully logged in and redirected to their dashboard.
Given an employee enters invalid credentials, they shall receive an error message and remain on the login page.
Given an employee attempts to access a protected resource without authentication, they shall be redirected to the login page.
The system shall enforce strong password policies.
User sessions shall be securely managed and automatically expire after a period of inactivity.

features.title: Leave Application Submission
features.description: Provides employees with a form to apply for various types of leave, specifying dates, reasons, and viewing their current leave balance before submission.
functional_requirements: Employees shall be able to view available leave balance.
Employees shall be able to apply for leave.
Employees shall be able to select leave type.
Employees shall be able to enter leave dates.
Employees shall be able to provide leave reason.
technical_notes: Frontend form validation for dates and mandatory fields.
Backend API for leave balance check and submission.
Database transaction for saving leave request.
acceptance_criteria: Given an employee navigates to the 'Apply Leave' section, they shall see their current leave balances for all applicable leave types.
When an employee fills the leave application form with valid data (leave type, start/end dates, reason) and submits, the request shall be successfully created and marked as 'Pending'.
When an employee attempts to submit a leave request exceeding their available balance for that type, the system shall prevent submission and display an appropriate error message.
When an employee selects a leave type, the system should guide them on relevant rules (e.g., minimum notice period, maximum duration).
The system shall prevent selection of past dates for leave application.

features.title: Personal Leave Tracking and History
features.description: Allows employees to view a comprehensive record of all their submitted leave requests, including current status and historical data.
functional_requirements: Employees shall be able to view leave history.
technical_notes: API endpoint to retrieve employee's full leave history.
Frontend component to display leave history in a sortable/filterable table.
Pagination for large history data sets.
acceptance_criteria: Given an employee accesses their 'Leave History' section, they shall see a list of all their leave requests, past and present.
Each entry in the leave history shall display leave type, start date, end date, duration, reason, and current status (e.g., Pending, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled).
The leave history shall be sortable by date and filterable by status or leave type.
Details of a specific leave request shall be viewable upon selection.

features.title: Pending Leave Request Cancellation
features.description: Provides employees with the capability to cancel their own leave requests that are still pending manager approval.
functional_requirements: Employees shall be able to cancel pending leave requests.
technical_notes: Backend API endpoint to update leave request status to 'Cancelled'.
Confirmation dialog on the frontend to prevent accidental cancellations.
Notification mechanism to inform manager of cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: Given an employee has a pending leave request, they shall see an option to 'Cancel' it in their leave history or detail view.
When an employee cancels a pending leave request, the request's status shall change to 'Cancelled' and their leave balance shall not be affected.
When a leave request has already been approved or rejected, the 'Cancel' option shall not be available.
The manager who was assigned to approve the request shall receive a notification about the cancellation.

epics.title: Managerial Leave Approval Workflow
epics.business_objective: Enable managers to efficiently review, approve, or reject employee leave requests and maintain visibility into their direct reports' leave history.
epics.business_value: Streamlines the approval process, ensures timely decisions, reduces communication overhead, and provides managers with necessary oversight for team planning.
epics.detailed_description: This Epic encompasses all functionalities for managers. It includes their secure login, a dashboard to view all pending leave requests from their direct reports, the ability to review details of each request, and to make approval or rejection decisions, including providing comments for rejection. Managers will also be able to view the leave history of their direct reports to aid in decision-making.
scope: Manager secure login and access to a dedicated dashboard.
Display of pending leave requests from direct reports.
Detailed view of each leave request, including employee details, leave type, dates, reason, and employee's current leave balance.
Option to approve a pending leave request.
Option to reject a pending leave request with a mandatory comment.
Ability to view a comprehensive leave history for each direct report.
out_of_scope: Mass approval or rejection of multiple requests.
Delegation of approval authority to other managers.
Integration with team calendars for conflict checking (beyond basic date overlap).
assumptions: Each employee has a clearly defined reporting manager in the system.
Managers only see requests from their direct reports.
Managers are notified of new pending requests (e.g., via email or dashboard notification).
The manager's decision is final for individual requests.
dependencies: Employee reporting structure must be configured.
Leave application submission process must be functional.
Notification service for decision alerts to employees.
risks: Delays in approval if managers do not regularly check the system.
Incorrect approvals/rejections due to insufficient information.
Security breach leading to unauthorized access to employee leave data.
Lack of audit trail for manager decisions.
success_metrics: Average time taken for a manager to approve/reject a request.
Percentage of leave requests approved/rejected via the system.

features.title: Manager Secure Authentication and Dashboard
features.description: Provides managers with secure login and a personalized dashboard displaying an overview of pending leave requests and relevant team information.
functional_requirements: Managers shall be able to login securely.
Managers shall be able to view pending leave requests.
technical_notes: Leverage existing authentication service (JWT).
Dashboard API to fetch summary of pending requests for the logged-in manager.
Frontend dashboard component design.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manager enters valid credentials, they shall be successfully logged in and redirected to their manager dashboard.
The manager dashboard shall prominently display a list or count of pending leave requests awaiting their review.
The dashboard shall only show pending requests from employees reporting directly to the logged-in manager.
Given a manager enters invalid credentials, they shall receive an error message.

features.title: Pending Leave Request Review
features.description: Allows managers to access a detailed view of each pending leave request, including employee information, leave details, and relevant history to inform their decision.
functional_requirements: Managers shall be able to view pending leave requests.
technical_notes: API endpoint to retrieve detailed information for a specific leave request.
Frontend component for displaying leave request details, including employee's remaining leave balance.
Ensure secure data access (manager can only view direct reports' data).
acceptance_criteria: Given a manager clicks on a pending leave request from their dashboard, they shall be presented with a detailed view of that request.

The detailed view shall include the employee's name, employee ID, department, requested leave type, start and end dates, total days, reason, and the employee's current available balance for the requested leave type.
The detailed view shall allow the manager to navigate back to the list of pending requests.
Managers shall be able to sort and filter pending requests by employee name, leave type, or submission date.

features.title: Leave Request Decision and Notification
features.description: Enables managers to approve or reject leave requests and provides a mechanism to add comments for rejections, with automatic notification to the employee.
functional_requirements: Managers shall be able to approve requests.
Managers shall be able to reject requests.
Managers shall be able to add comments while rejecting.
technical_notes: Backend APIs for 'approve' and 'reject' actions, updating leave request status.
Integration with an email notification service.
Validation for mandatory rejection comments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manager views a pending leave request, they shall see 'Approve' and 'Reject' buttons.
When a manager clicks 'Approve', the request status shall change to 'Approved', and the employee's leave balance shall be deducted accordingly.
When a manager clicks 'Reject', a comment field shall appear, and upon submission with a comment, the request status shall change to 'Rejected'.
A rejection comment shall be mandatory when rejecting a request.
The employee who submitted the request shall receive an automatic notification (e.g., email) about the decision, including rejection comments if applicable.
The system shall record the manager's ID and the timestamp of the decision.

features.title: Employee Leave History Viewing for Managers
features.description: Allows managers to view the complete leave history of their direct reports to assist in decision-making and team management.
functional_requirements: Managers shall be able to view employee leave history.
technical_notes: API endpoint to retrieve leave history for a specific employee (filtered by manager's direct reports).
Frontend component to display employee leave history in a readable format.
Ensure manager can only view history of direct reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given a manager accesses the system, they shall have an option to view the leave history for any of their direct reports.
The employee leave history view shall display all past, approved, and rejected leave requests for the selected employee.
Each history entry shall include leave type, dates, duration, reason, and final status (Approved/Rejected/Cancelled).
The manager shall not be able to view leave history for employees who are not their direct reports.

epics.title: HR Administration & Policy Management
epics.business_objective: Provide HR administrators with robust tools to manage employee accounts, configure leave policies, update balances, and generate organization-wide leave reports.
epics.business_value: Ensures data accuracy, facilitates compliance with HR policies, enables efficient onboarding and offboarding, and provides critical insights for workforce planning.
epics.detailed_description: This Epic covers all administrative functionalities for HR personnel. It includes secure HR login, capabilities to create, modify, and deactivate employee accounts, define and update organizational leave policies (e.g., maximum leave days per type), adjust individual employee leave balances, and generate comprehensive reports on organizational leave patterns and utilization. This centralizes HR's control over the leave management framework.
scope: HR administrator secure login and access to a dedicated HR module.
Functionality to create new employee accounts with basic details (name, employee ID, department, reporting manager).
Ability to modify existing employee account details.
Mechanism to define, update, and manage various leave policies (e.g., accrual rates, maximum carry-over, eligibility rules).
Tools to manually adjust individual employee leave balances.
Generation of organization-wide leave reports, including summaries by department, leave type, and utilization rates.
Ability to view detailed leave history for any employee in the organization.
out_of_scope: Full HRIS (Human Resources Information System) functionality beyond leave management.
Advanced predictive analytics on leave trends.
Automated integration with third-party HR systems for employee data synchronization (manual HR account creation is assumed).
Employee self-service for updating personal details (handled by a separate HRIS or direct HR contact).
assumptions: HR administrators are responsible for the initial setup and ongoing maintenance of employee accounts.
HR has the authority to override system-calculated leave balances.
Leave policies are defined at an organizational level, potentially with departmental variations.
HR administrators require access to all employee leave data for reporting and auditing purposes.
dependencies: Database for employee master data, leave policies, and leave requests.
risks: Unauthorized access to sensitive HR data.
Incorrect policy configuration leading to system errors or employee dissatisfaction.
Data entry errors during manual balance updates.
Performance issues with large-scale report generation.
Lack of audit trail for HR actions.
success_metrics: Accuracy rate of leave balances and policy adherence.
Reduction in manual HR tasks related to leave management.
Timeliness and accuracy of HR reports.
Number of HR support tickets related to system configuration.

features.title: HR Secure Authentication and Access
features.description: Ensures HR administrators can securely log into the system and access HR-specific functionalities based on their role.
functional_requirements: HR administrators shall be able to login securely.
Role-based access.
technical_notes: Implement specific roles for HR users within the authentication system.
Enforce strict access control policies for HR module endpoints.
Audit logging for HR login attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Given an HR administrator enters valid credentials, they shall be successfully logged in and granted access to the HR module.
HR administrators shall not be able to access manager or employee specific functionalities directly.
Given an HR administrator enters invalid credentials, they shall receive an error message.
Access to HR functions shall be restricted to users with the 'HR Admin' role.

features.title: Employee Account Management
features.description: Allows HR administrators to create, modify, and deactivate employee accounts within the leave management system.
functional_requirements: HR administrators shall be able to create employee accounts.
non_functional_requirements: Audit logging for all HR changes.
technical_notes: Backend API for CRUD operations on employee records.
Frontend forms for creating and editing employee details.
Data validation for mandatory fields (e.g., employee ID, name, reporting manager).
acceptance_criteria: Given an HR administrator, they shall be able to navigate to an 'Employee Management' section.
When creating a new employee account, HR shall provide essential details like Employee ID, Name, Department, and Reporting Manager.
Upon successful creation, the new employee account shall be active and ready for use.
HR shall be able to search for existing employees and modify their details (e.g., update department or reporting manager).
HR shall be able to deactivate an employee account, preventing them from logging in or applying for leave.
All changes to employee accounts shall be logged with a timestamp and the HR administrator's ID.

features.title: Leave Policy and Balance Configuration
features.description: Provides HR with tools to define and update leave policies and manually adjust individual employee leave balances.
functional_requirements: HR administrators shall be able to modify leave policies.
HR administrators shall be able to update leave balances.
non_functional_requirements: Audit logging for all configuration changes.
technical_notes: Backend API for managing leave types and policies (e.g., max days, accrual rules).
Backend API for manual adjustment of employee leave balances.
Frontend configuration screens for policy definition and balance updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given an HR administrator, they shall be able to define new leave types and associated policies (e.g., annual entitlement, maximum consecutive days, eligibility).
HR shall be able to modify existing leave policies, and these changes shall take effect immediately for future applications.
HR shall be able to search for an employee and manually adjust their leave balance for any leave type, with a mandatory reason for adjustment.
The system shall automatically reset annual leave balances as per configured policy on a specified date (e.g., Jan 1st).
All policy modifications and manual balance adjustments shall be logged with the HR administrator's ID and timestamp.

features.title: Organization-Wide Leave Reporting
features.description: Enables HR administrators to generate comprehensive reports on leave utilization across the organization.
functional_requirements: HR administrators shall be able to view organization-wide leave reports.
non_functional_requirements: Response time below 5 seconds for complex reports.
technical_notes: Backend service for generating aggregated leave data.
Frontend interface for report generation, including filtering and date range selection.
Support for exporting reports (e.g., CSV, PDF).
acceptance_criteria: Given an HR administrator, they shall be able to access a 'Reports' section within the HR module.
HR shall be able to generate reports summarizing leave utilization by department, leave type, and selected date range.
Reports shall display aggregated data such as total leave days taken, number of requests, and average leave duration.
HR shall be able to filter reports by specific criteria (e.g., leave type, department, employee status).
Generated reports shall be downloadable in a common format (e.g., CSV).
The system shall provide a visual representation (e.g., charts) for key report metrics if feasible.
